remarks: Step into a brand new studio apartment at 61 East Avenue, Norwalk. This upper-level unit, located on a serene 0.56-acre corner lot, offers 400 sq. ft. of space equipped with modern appliances, a convenient laundry area with washer and dryer, and laminate flooring. Featuring pre-wired cable and Energy Star-rated efficiency with electric heating, it promises a comfortable, low-maintenance lifestyle. As part of a two-unit complex, it benefits from easy access to city amenities like parks, transit, and shopping. Exterior maintenance is included, ensuring a hassle-free residence. Ideal for those valuing practicality and convenience.
